sources.finding: Explicitly states no live FLOP token, mint, claim, presale or airdrop. Testnet working target 3 November 2026, not a fixed date.

Official corpus listed by flop.finance/official. Creating a DID or posting it to Technocore earns nothing; agent participation requires actual inference use when testnet opens. Devnet has no rewards or airdrop weight.
Draft allocation and separate ecosystem programme terms; not evidence that this code-review contribution earns allocation.
Opening is readiness-gated; older quarter-only text should be read alongside the newer official target.
Latest posts inaccessible through the web tool (403); no claim of independent current X verification.

decision: No live official airdrop task established. Proceed with useful technical validation as a contribution, not token farming.
